title: custom_evo zombie recovery uses wrong code path (submit_next_loop instead of submit_custom_evo_loop), causing FULL_TRAIN seed validation failure
description:
Expected: Zombie recovery (_safe_submit_or_fail) should detect custom_evo task_type and delegate to submit_custom_evo_loop, which reads loop config from strategy_evo_config.loops (including runtime_flags.random_seed), and calls _submit_custom_evo_loop_unified → build_config_from_custom_evo_loop → ensure_loop_fixed_seed. This properly extracts the fixed seed from the loop-specific config.
Actual: _safe_submit_or_fail unconditionally calls submit_next_loop. submit_next_loop is designed for auto-evolution tasks — it loads config from reviewer.validated_config (previous loop) or falls back to _load_base_config_from_experiment(task["base_experiment_id"]). Neither source contains the loop-specific runtime_flags.random_seed. BacktestExecutor.submit() at backtest.py:72-75 performs seed validation: require_fixed_seed=True && fixed_seed is None → raises ValueError("FULL_TRAIN requires runtime_flags.random_seed"). The error is caught at line 1768, L13 marked as failed, but the task stays in "running" state, creating a zombie retry loop every 10 minutes.
reproduce_command:
1. Create a custom_evo task with 16 loops and parallelism=2 on a single node (wsl2-5080)
2. Let L1-L12 complete normally (parallel batches of 2)
3. After L12 completes, L13 will be submitted by zombie recovery which calls submit_next_loop → uses base_experiment config without runtime_flags.random_seed → ValueError: FULL_TRAIN requires runtime_flags.random_seed
4. System retries every 10 minutes in infinite loop, never recovering

Concrete repro: task qe_20260522_012542_90fb on AIstock backend, loop_statuses show L13 failed with null experiment_id

events.note: Root cause: In submit_next_loop (line 1599), there is no custom_evo task_type detection. The zombie recovery at _safe_submit_or_fail (line 2397) always calls submit_next_loop regardless of task_type.

Fix direction: In submit_next_loop, after status check (line 1615), add: if task.get('task_type') == 'custom_evo': next = (task['current_loop'] or 0) + 1; return await self.submit_custom_evo_loop(task_id, next). This delegates to the correct code path that reads strategy_evo_config.loops.

Affected experiments: qe_20260522_012542_90fb L13-L16 all blocked. L13 uses label_horizon=5 (different from baseline 10D), L14 uses label_horizon=20, L15-L16 use legacy 5M cap strategy. These horizon/strategy differences are intentional experiment design, validated in loop config, but irrelevant to this bug — the seed is simply missing from the base_experiment config used by the wrong code path.
